name: Amagi Manami
source:
Manami is an air headed girl who works as a waitress at a nearby restaurant. While she is usually passive, she has taken a liking to Ryuichi and is not afraid to show it. Despite looking harmless, she is very well trained in judo since her family runs a dojo.

[From [url=https://www.jastusa.com/sweet-home]JAST USA[/url]]
